sentences.text:
Smt. Nupur Khanna vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 16
October, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:199669
Court No. - 82
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 1230 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Nupur Khanna

entities.text: Nupur Khanna vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Ayank Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.G.A. for the State as also perused the material available on record.

By means of the present application filed under Section 483 Cr.P.C., the applicant has prayed for a direction to the court below, namely, the Civil Judge (Junior Division) F.T.C.II, Gautam Budh Nagar to conclude the trial of Case No. 3064 of 2022 (State Vs. Paras and Others) arising out of Case Crime No. 0094 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 504 and 406 I.P.C., Police Station-Mahila Thana,
District-Gautam Budh Nagar, within stipulated period as may be fixed by this Court

entities.text: Civil Judge (Junior Division) F.T.C.II, Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Case No. 3064 of 2022 (State Vs. Paras and Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
After hearing the learned A.G.A. for the State and perusing the materials brought on record as well as without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is disposed of by providing that the court below shall consider and conclude the trial of the above mentioned case, in accordance with law, by means of a reasoned and speaking order, expeditiously preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of a certified copy of this order if there is no other legal impediment.
